description: A nine-panel composite of transmission electron micrographs documenting planar slip of dislocations in ferrite (α) of two Fe-Mn-Al-C low-density steels. (a) 10Al α bright-field TEM, 500 nm scale bar, showing dislocation slip bands with red arrows tracing a band, a white dashed box marking the region enlarged in (b), and a bottom-left SAED inset with a red dashed diamond and a circled reflection annotated (110), Z=[100]. (b) 10Al α magnified view, 50 nm scale bar, with red labels "Screw" and "Pairing" on the band. (c) 10Al α dark-field TEM formed with the (1-1-1) DO3 superlattice reflection, 50 nm scale bar, showing coarse bright ordered domains in a dark matrix. (d) 8Al α bright-field TEM, 500 nm, blue arrows marking slip bands, dashed box for (e), SAED inset labelled (112) and (110), Z=[100]. (e) 8Al α magnified view, 100 nm, labels "Screw", "Pairing", "Edge" and "Mixed". (f) 8Al α DO3 dark-field, 100 nm, showing weak mottled contrast. (g) HRTEM along [100], 10 nm, positions 1 and 2, dashed slip plane, red "Dislocation" arrow, inset with circled (01-1) and (0-11). (h, i) IFFT images of positions 1 and 2, 5 nm, resolving dislocation dipoles along the slip plane. The group argues that DO3 order forces dislocations to travel in pairs, so slip stays planar; 10Al shows more pairs and larger ordered domains than 8Al.

observations.observation: Panel (a) is a bright-field TEM image of '10Al α' with a 500 nm scale bar showing planar dislocation slip bands traced by red arrows.
The (a) SAED inset contains a red dashed diamond of reflections with one circled and annotated (110), and the zone axis marked Z=[100].
Panel (b) is a magnified view of the boxed region of (a) at 50 nm scale with the words 'Screw' and 'Pairing' printed in red next to dislocation lines.
Panel (d) is a bright-field TEM image of '8Al α' with a 500 nm scale bar, slip bands marked by blue arrows and a boxed region for (e); its inset pattern is labelled (112) and (110), Z=[100].
Panel (e) (8Al α, 100 nm scale bar) labels distinct dislocation types as 'Screw' (red), 'Pairing' (blue), 'Edge' (blue) and 'Mixed' (magenta).

Panels (c) and (f) are TEM dark-field images formed with the (1-1-1) DO3 superlattice reflection, showing ordered-domain contrast; the contrast is markedly coarser/brighter in 10Al (c) than in 8Al (f).

Panel (g) is an HRTEM image along the [100] zone axis with 10 nm scale bar, positions 1 and 2 marked, a dashed slip plane and a red arrow labelled 'Dislocation'; its inset circles (01-1) and (0-11) reflections.
Panels (h) and (i) are IFFT images (5 nm scale bars) of positions 1 and 2 in (g), resolving dislocation dipoles arranged along the labelled slip plane.

The caption states (b) and (e) are enlarged views of parts of (a) and (d), (c) and (f) are TEM dark-field images using the (1-1-1) DO3 superlattice reflection, (g) is high-resolution along the [100] zone axis, and (h, i) are IFFT images of positions 1 and 2 along the (01 1) and (0 1 1) planes.
The citing text states that dislocation pairing is extreme in 10Al steel with up to six dislocation pairs and spacings as small as approximately 3 nm.

The citing text states the number of dislocation pairs usually does not exceed 6 pairs in 10Al steel and 3 pairs in 8Al steel, giving estimated DO3 ordered domain sizes of 3.0 nm and 1.5 nm respectively (12 pairs vs 6 pairs).
The citing text states TEM-observed DO3 ordered domain sizes are 19 nm for 10Al steel and 2.1 nm for 8Al steel, and that the large domains in 10Al cannot be completely sheared while those in 8Al can.

The citing text attributes planar slip to anti-phase boundaries (APBs) left behind when DO3 ordered domains are sheared, the APB attractive force increasing with Al content and thereby strengthening dislocation pairing.

subfigures.description: Bright-field TEM of 10Al α, 500 nm scale bar, with planar dislocation slip bands marked by red arrows; white dashed box marks the region enlarged in (b). Bottom-left SAED inset shows a red dashed diamond with a circled (110) reflection, Z=[100].
Enlarged bright-field TEM view of the boxed region of (a), 10Al α, 50 nm scale bar, with red annotations 'Screw' and 'Pairing' identifying dislocation lines and paired dislocations.
TEM dark-field image of 10Al α formed with the (1-1-1) DO3 superlattice reflection, 50 nm scale bar; coarse bright DO3-ordered domains in a dark matrix, domain boundaries diffuse.

Bright-field TEM of 8Al α, 500 nm scale bar, planar slip bands marked by blue arrows; white dashed box marks the region enlarged in (e). Inset SAED with red dashed diamond, labels (112) and (110), Z=[100].

Enlarged bright-field TEM view of the boxed region of (d), 8Al α, 100 nm scale bar, with labels 'Screw' (red), 'Pairing' (blue), 'Edge' (blue) and 'Mixed' (magenta) on different dislocation configurations.
TEM dark-field image of 8Al α using the DO3 superlattice reflection, 100 nm scale bar; very low-contrast, fine mottled domain contrast, individual domains not clearly resolved.

High-resolution TEM image along the [100] zone axis, 10 nm scale bar; positions '1' and '2' boxed, a dashed 'slip plane' line and a red 'Dislocation' arrow; inset diffraction pattern with circled (01-1) and (0-11) spots.
IFFT image of position 1 in (g), 5 nm scale bar, showing a dashed 'slip plane' and ladder/T-shaped dislocation dipole contrast along the slip plane.
IFFT image of position 2 in (g), 5 nm scale bar, with dashed 'slip plane' line and dislocation dipole contrast; inset shows spots labelled (01-1), (0-11) and Z=[100].
